title: Chilli in a Side Bowl
story: The junior club ended its season with a potluck supper in the sports hall. Each household was asked to bring one dish and a card listing what was in it, because two players had food allergies. Tomas arrived with a bean stew his grandmother had taught him, mild enough for children, with pickled chilli served in a separate bowl. He wrote that choice clearly on the card so nobody would be surprised by the heat. During the meal a parent thanked him, because her son could eat the stew without avoiding the whole pot. The coach then asked him to help write a guide so strong flavour could be offered beside a dish instead of being stirred through it. Tomas agreed. He went home with an empty pot and a recipe for oat biscuits from another family. The supper was simple, but people could eat together without guessing what was safe.

quiz.supportingSentence: The supper was simple, but people could eat together without guessing what was safe.

Cards placed beside a supper dish
A mild stew taught by a relative
Sweet oat cakes from another family
quiz.correctAnswer: Harmful reactions that some foods can cause
quiz.explanation: The cards were required because two players had food allergies, meaning some foods could make them ill.
